title: Adaptive cloud laboratory reveals optical chirality in perovskite nanocrystals
summary: An automated laboratory used measured feedback and fitted local optimization models to search for optically active CsPbBr3 nanocrystals. Spectroscopy measured circular dichroism and imaging informed a proposed defect-related explanation. The composition was known; the contribution is an experimentally characterized optical property and its optimization. The proposed mechanism and future device applications are not independently established.
ai_technology: SNOBFIT adaptive optimization with locally fitted quadratic models
